children: Ramaco Resources said a distribution of roughly one million Class A shares by major holder Yorktown Energy Partners likely drove negative trading on September 3, 2026.
Yorktown Energy Partners distributed about one million Ramaco Class A shares to its limited partners on Sept 2, 2026.
Company believes that distribution contributed to negative trading activity in its Class A stock on Sept 3, 2026.
Statement was issued via press release filed as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K dated Sept 4, 2026.
Information in Item 7.01 and Exhibit 99.1 is furnished, not filed, and not subject to Section 18 liabilities.
